acceptance_criterion: Every status change writes a history entry containing previous status, new status, the acting user, their role, the timestamp, and the triggering action
test_name: writes the first status history entry for the submission (F1)

acceptance_criterion: An attempted transition that is not permitted from the current status is refused, and the message names the current status and the attempted target
test_name: names the current status and the attempted target when it refuses

acceptance_criterion: A venue record holds name, building/location, maximum capacity, supported room layouts with the capacity for each layout, facilities, accessibility features, and operating hours per day of week
test_name: lets Venue Staff create a venue holding every catalogue attribute

acceptance_criterion: Maximum capacity and each per-layout capacity must be whole numbers greater than zero
test_name: refuses a layout capacity of 0 or a fraction, naming the layout's row

acceptance_criterion: At least one layout must be recorded
Only Venue Staff can create or update venue records; other internal roles have read access only, and an update attempt by them changes nothing
test_name: refuses an update by %s and changes nothing

acceptance_criterion: Each create or update records the acting user and the timestamp, and retains the previous values of changed fields
test_name: lets any Venue Staff member update a venue, recording only the changed fields with their previous values

acceptance_criterion: Marking a venue inactive retains its existing bookings, its history, and its visibility on the availability calendar
test_name: marks a venue inactive, keeping the record and recording the change

acceptance_criterion: A rejected update leaves every stored venue field unchanged
test_name: leaves every stored field unchanged when the update is refused
